integrity: Proof supplied for all universal statements. Finite rational computations are supplementary and do not establish infinite-dimensional claims; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotics require fixed rank-one monomial index; no uniform-in-index exponential rate is asserted.
Only the explicitly defined radial harmonic-Bergman unital completely positive map is classified; arbitrary completely positive maps and noncompact initial operators are outside scope.
Full text of relevant Li–Gao–Zhao–Ma (2024) spectral study was not accessible, and equivalent prior formulations cannot be excluded; mathematical priority has not been independently confirmed.
title: Sharp compact-operator relaxation for harmonic Bergman Toeplitz channels
